_about: What Contoso collected before this module. Each key is one telemetry source the simulator writes only if it is true here.
name: first-draft
_activity_log: The subscription's Activity log, exported to the Log Analytics workspace (table AzureActivity): control-plane operations such as listKeys and diagnosticSettings/delete.
_apim_gateway_logs: ApiManagementGatewayLogs: one row per call through the API Management gateway (caller IP, APIM subscription, response code). No prompts.
_foundry_resource_logs: The Foundry resource has a diagnostic setting, but it sends the Audit category only: no RequestResponse or Trace rows in AzureDiagnostics, so calls that skip the gateway are invisible. (The built-in policy 'Diagnostic logs in Azure AI services resources should be enabled' still reports it compliant: lesson 16.4.)
_apim_llm_logs: Log LLM messages is off on the API: no ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog rows (no prompts, no completions, no token counts).
_defender_ai_services: Defender for Cloud is on, but the AI services plan was never turned on: no AI alerts in SecurityAlert.
_agent_traces: Foundry tracing is off by default and nobody turned it on: no invoke_agent or execute_tool spans.
_storage_logs: No diagnostic setting on the knowledge base storage account: no StorageBlobLogs.
_deploy_log: The agent pipeline's own run log stays in the CI system; nothing reaches the workspace.
_app_log_identity: The web app logs path, status and latency. No end-user ID, no session ID, no correlation ID. It doesn't pass user_security_context.
